title: Stereoselective synthesis of P-stereogenic nucleotide prodrugs and oligonucleotides
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,9370-9406
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00260E, Review Article
Jia-Bao Wang, Ji Yuan Lv, Siddheshwar Kisan Bankar, Shuai-Shuai Fang, Ming Shang
